JNJNCASR · Research internship Upcoming

JNCASR Summer Research Fellowship Programme 2027

Two-month research fellowship in a JNCASR lab in Bengaluru, across chemistry, physics, materials, engineering mechanics and life sciences.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹10,000
Stipend details
₹10,000 per month (₹20,000 for the 8-week programme), paid after successful completion.
Expected application deadline
To be confirmed
Format & location
In person · Bengaluru
Who can apply
UG/PG students in science, engineering, technology, medicine or veterinary sciences (eligible years vary by discipline); 65%+ in Class X, XII and core subjects plus first class in recent semesters.
Accommodation & support
No free housing (host institution arranges stay; campus accommodation at JNCASR is paid) · travel reimbursed at actuals, up to ₹5,000

Entry notes

  • 2026 window: 22 December 2025 to 31 January 2026, ₹500 fee. Expect similar dates for 2027.
